en: Black‑and‑white view down a cobblestone street lined with historic multi‑story townhouses in a European city. The façades feature arched windows, ornamental cornices, and some neo‑Gothic or neo‑Renaissance details. Parked 1960s–1970s style cars appear in the foreground and mid‑ground; a few pedestrians walk along the sidewalk. One corner building has a small projecting bay and ornate reliefs. The scene is calm and appears to be from a historic inner‑city street.
